title: Lior and the Alibi
author: Silas Amberdale
blurb: Ines Vane, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
